purpose: Normative adapter contracts. Qualification here is offline and limited to the stated fixture profile.

inputs: native faction, station and fuel evaluators
rules: Target selection runs only while this mission owns control; native selection can reset routes.
No station is created, forced reachable or made friendly by the executive.
Already-stranded actors and native cleanup policy require a separate adapter before adoption.

state: native world ShipSitu/NavData snapshot and existing fuel settlement state
rules: Pilot unavailability is not completion.
An existing authorized route can continue without new pilot input.
Native authored CanExecute skip is not proof that an arrival prerequisite was met.
Failure revokes movement and requests a policy decision; it does not advance to docking or impose endless retries.
Current native fuel and geometry repairs remain lower-level services.

inputs: certified invocation boundary (standalone checkpoint or coherent native-save operation fence)
state: one pending effect ID and destination
bounded native adapter participant manifest and witnessed destruction outcomes
rules: Intent preparation and InvocationBoundaryReady certification must precede native invocation.
A restored prepared record is ambiguous until world readback resolves it.
Command return codes and lack of visible attachment do not prove crew/cargo transaction outcome.
Only proof that the world-effect seam was not entered permits another invocation.

The native-arrival provider executes DockAndDespawn and shipped drop-off/reputation decisions for mixed group crew; physical scene movement/destruction and company policy remain providers or open gates.
All captured crew must be at the destination or have a witnessed native destruction outcome; absence alone cannot complete retirement.
Readback can continue after native unregister for the same canonical hull without resubmitting docking.
The standalone fixture uses one checkpoint file. The integrated native save port uses a fenced in-memory intent and performs no per-arrival disk write.
Only a coherent native snapshot with a matching original prepared phase can prove that native invocation had not begun; ordinary standalone prepared records remain ambiguous.

inputs: native engagement choice, target, sensors and weapon eligibility
state: canonical combat goal and native negotiation blackboard
explicit tactical waypoint and native FlyTo payload
outcomes: native policy choice to return, surrender or react
rules: Do not run embedded LowFuelRetreat as a hidden second mission controller.
Low-fuel retreat is a native policy decision translated into an explicit return mission.
Damage, defeat, hostility, unsafe policy choices and native weapon limits remain authoritative.
No synthetic combat outcome during bulk travel.
Native role tree guards/actions run in authored order; embedded combat/retreat controllers are forbidden.
Equipment eligibility/profile and empty weapon list are fixtures; no actual projectile/decoy outcome claim.
Active Ceres reserve/home selection integration remains unqualified.

inputs: native urgent directive with full payload and source context
state: explicit target/direction, remaining reaction and pause clocks
original gravity flag and started marker
suspended mission identity and named missile-check interval
rules: Ordinary patrol admission is not an urgent directive.
Completing a reaction does not resurrect stale movement authority.
Resume requires target and capability revalidation.
Repeated urgent inputs must respect bounded admission; never silently discard an authored event.
Native WeaponsSystem publishes DodgeTarget after enqueue; read context at dispatch or capture from its producer.
Repeated dodge updates context without stacking reactions or resetting the shared timer.
Missing-target completion must restore owned gravity state too.
Native assets retain acceptance, reputation, faction and condition policy.
Counterparty, issuer, loot arguments, one-shot semantics, FIFO and expiry are part of the input contract.
Unknown or unsupported directives prevent adoption or require a certified handback; they must not disappear.
The listed aliases are examples checked against shipped assets, not complete authored-command closure.
Direct shipped CMD aliases and core/generated-stakes references are inventoried in authored-inputs.json; recursive conditional closure remains open.
ApplyLoot character receives the effects; it is not necessarily the issuer.
External subsystem directives first release executive authority; their native outcomes remain unqualified.
New TakeFuel commands execute the native constructor at receipt; reconstruction restores its reviewed fields without replaying SyncFuel or restarting its pause.
Primitive shared clocks restore from the native world, not an older per-command sample; delayed receipts and reaction checkpoints retain the latest write.
Raw full-inbox admission refuses before construction. Typed callers have already constructed their command before AddCommand; no rollback guarantee is claimed.
Native TakeFuel and SyncFuel match an uninterrupted native baseline under physical-tank and docking providers; real gas/container storage remains unqualified.
Selected shipped surrender replies execute native GetReply, Triggered, person/ship-spec and relationship evaluators; personality scoring, crew effects and scene presentation remain fixtures.
Native comms DTOs restore roles, chain context, received logs and pending-message identities without replaying command loot or receipt effects.
The native send queue deduplicates messages. Delivery event fanout is a fixture with the native strict timestamp rule, not a qualified Unity event lifecycle.
Capture executive state with the native DTO under the owner-thread operation fence; do not write an independent later sidecar.
Detach mutable DTO references before handing the snapshot to the native save worker.
Bind native wire data, epoch and versioned executive state; native LitJson can normalize empty arrays to null when reading.
Raw command receipt is fenced before construction. Arbitrary typed constructors executing before admission are not covered by that guard.
Physical ship/inventory serialization, unrelated subsystem snapshots and Unity scene restoration retain explicit providers.
The experimental fingerprint/copy path is allocation-heavy; no runtime performance or generic uninstall guarantee is claimed.
Ordinary funded Navy return may project target, native flight state and main cursor 2 or 3, provided no native combat or queued directive conflicts.
Check native serialization before releasing executive authority.
After release, executive event admission, ticking and time advance are disabled, including after reload.
Nested combat retreat, suspended missions, pending world effects and unqualified profiles defer disable without erasing their policy state.
A retired actor is a qualified release boundary. Generic removal/upgrade compatibility is not established.
A native MainBehavior patrol approach to a non-docking waypoint may export its flight payload and main cursor 2; native archive reload and dispatcher continuation are fixture-qualified.
The executive inbox and reaction state must be checked in addition to the native queue; handback cannot silently discard their work.
There is one world interval owner; actors do not independently advance StarSystem time in production.
A route uses actual elapsed time to its boundary and the next phase receives only the residual interval.
Persist the existing native fuel settlement watermark instead of adding a competing fuel ledger.
The native queue budget remains authoritative; no new per-frame whole-world polling or background Unity access.
Tests cross native 3600-second catch-up threshold and retain unrelated shallow player torch playback.
Bulk combat is refused offline; no production restriction or fabricated outcome is selected.
Coordinate outside the native Update prefix chain so later prefixes cannot create a phantom future interval.
GUI SFF uses existing production scopes; experimental PASS binding calls their factories without changing GUIFFWD.Active and honors module flags.
Retained motion can coast executive-owned actors but must not infer independent navigation from stale native active-command labels.
Native market algorithms, existing freighter controller and retained timeline run under synthetic data; physical scene and crew outcomes retain fixtures.
A negative control still reproduces non-GUI successful route completion falling through into full-interval integration; opening scopes alone is not a complete PASS repair.
Native dispatch occurs between bounded daily windows; uncertain arrival blocks residual time and scope finalizers release writers on failure.
